summary: Gray Media filed an 8-K reporting the repurchase of $100M of its 10.500% senior secured first lien notes due 2029 and $20M of its 5.375% senior notes due 2031, both at par plus accrued interest in a privately negotiated transaction on July 21, 2026. Funded via cash on hand and revolver borrowings, this debt reduction improves capital structure and signals management's confidence in cash flows. With no premium or tender offer mechanics, watch for further debt management or leverage metric improvement as ongoing capital allocation focus.
